title: Labby Code Mode Retained Slice Response
description: Successful return value of the sandbox helper `codemode.slice(handle, path, range)`. The selection is always returned whole — a selection that would exceed the per-call result ceiling raises `retained_value_too_large` instead of being silently truncated.

path.description: The RFC 6901 pointer that was resolved, echoed back verbatim.

value.description: The selected sub-value, after any range window. Any JSON type.

truncated.description: Always false. Slice never truncates; it errors instead. Present so callers can assert completeness without inspecting sizes.

range_applied.description: The effective window after clamping, present only when a range was supplied.

source_length.description: Length of the value at `path` before the range was applied — array elements or string chars. Present only when a range was supplied. Lets a pager detect the end of the sequence without a second fetch.
